basic_details.job_title: INSA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Assistant, Project Associate and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Indian National Science Academy (INSA), New Delhi, described in the notice as a Professional Body of Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India, has invited applications for 8 posts on a purely contractual basis for one year. The posts are Assistant (Publications), Project Associate-I/Senior Project Associate, System & Network Support Engineer, Assistant (Administration), Project Associate (INSPIRE) and Principal Project Associate. The salary will be decided by the selection committee on the basis of qualification and experience. Candidates must email the prescribed application for

how_to_apply: Get the application form. It is given in the notice as Annexure-II and is also available on the Academy's website www.insaindia.res.in under the head 'Career'.
Write the post name on the form and the advertisement number and date.

Fill in the curriculum vitae part: name in block letters, father's/husband's name, date of birth, telephone/mobile number, email address, address for communication, permanent address, present age (yy/mm), educational/technical qualification, experience and details of computer knowledge. Attach an additional sheet if required.

Affix a self-attested recent passport size photograph. Sign the declaration that the information is true, that you have read the terms in Annexure-I, and that no disciplinary/criminal proceedings are pending against you.
Email the application with the supporting documents to [email protected] till 21 November 2026 (Saturday), 6.00 p.m.
Hard copies may also be sent to: The Deputy Executive Director-I (F & A), Indian National Science Academy, Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi-110002.
Candidates must have a valid active email ID and mobile number and must fill them in the form correctly and legibly. The Academy will not be responsible for bouncing of any email sent to candidates.

content_sections.heading: About INSA
content_sections.text: The Indian National Science Academy is based at Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi-110002, and the notice describes it as a Professional Body of Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. The posts are being filled to manage the Human Resource and Development activities of the Academy. The notice is issued by Sunil Zokarkar, Dy. Executive Director-I (F & A).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: INSA has notified 8 posts in total across six designations. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience: minimum 3 (three) years in case of Bachelors' or one (1) year in case of Masters'. The experience must be in editing, proof reading and publishing science journals/science magazines/science books. It must be gained in Central/State Governments/Autonomous organization/Universities/Reputed organization. Working knowledge of computer applications is required. Bachelors' degree holders: minimum 4 (four) years' experience in Finance and Accounts Section in Central/State Govt./Autonomous Organization/Universities/Reputed Organizations. OR: for a person holding a Postgraduate Degree in Commerce/MBA (Finance), the requirement is minimum 2 (two) years' experience in the Finance and Accounts Section of the same kind of organisations. Internship in Finance & Accounts/CA article ship will also be considered as experience. Desirable: Diploma in Computer Applications. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in: Office System & network maintenance and troubleshooting, managing and coordinating with AMC engineers and handling open resolution calls, Antivirus/endpoint protection updates and system patching, Internet and LAN/WAN connectivity support. Server/storage/device support, Network cabling, switch configuration, and structured network upgrade work (preferred), e-Office implementation/support (preferred). Online / hybrid meeting arrangements on tools like Webex, Zoom, Google Meet etc. Essential skills: Good working knowledge of network and system maintenance in an office environment. Basic understanding of L3 switches, structured cabling, LAN management, Wi-fi management, firewall/antivirus, and system updates. Strong noting, drafting, documentation, and email communication skills. Ability to prepare technical notes, call logs, status reports, and coordinate with vendors. Desirable qualifications: CCNA / Network+ / equivalent networking certification. Experience in a government office IT environment. Exposure to e-Office, digital workflows, and user migration support. Experience: minimum 3 (three) years in case of Bachelors' or one (1) year in case of Masters'. The experience must be in HR/Administration/Establishment in Central/State Governments/Autonomous organization/Universities/Reputed organization. Working knowledge of computer applications is required. Proficiency: English/Hindi Typing speed (30 wpm). Good knowledge of MS office (Excel, Powerpoint, Word) etc. Three years' experience in Government organization/reputed organization, along with a Masters' degree in Science. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary will be decided by the selection committee on the basis of the candidate's qualification and experience. Selected candidates will be paid a fixed remuneration/consolidated salary per month. No other allowances and benefits will be paid. The engagement is for 1 year. It can be extended further subject to the requirement of the Academy, on the basis of the candidate's performance. Leave is as per Academy guidelines. No remuneration will be paid for absence beyond the admissible leave. Un-availed leave cannot be carried forward or encashed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for INSA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have a valid active email ID and mobile number and must fill them in the form correctly and legibly. The Academy will not be responsible for bouncing of any email sent to candidates.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: INSA will select candidates based on qualification, experience and performance in the interview. The notice does not give the interview date or venue.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in INSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 posts: 2 Assistant (Publications), 2 Project Associate-I/Senior Project Associate, and 1 each of System & Network Support Engineer, Assistant (Administration), Project Associate (INSPIRE) and Principal Project Associate.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for INSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed to [email protected] till 21 November 2026 (Saturday), 6.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the INSA Project Associate (INSPIRE) post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in any branch with minimum 55% marks or a Bachelor's degree with minimum 60% marks from a recognized university, along with English/Hindi typing speed of 30 wpm and good knowledge of MS Office.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for INSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For all six posts, the age must be not exceeding 40 years as on date of advertisement (the notice is dated 6 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What salary will INSA pay for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection committee will decide the salary on the basis of qualification and experience. It is a fixed consolidated monthly salary, and no other allowances or benefits will be paid.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for INSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form from Annexure-II or the 'Career' section of www.insaindia.res.in, then email it with supporting documents to [email protected]. Hard copies may also be sent to Indian National Science Academy, Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi-110002.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on qualification, experience and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the INSA job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for 1 year, extendable based on the Academy's requirement and the candidate's performance. It carries no right to absorption or regularization.

faq.question: Q9. How much experience is needed for the System & Network Support Engineer post?
faq.answer: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in office system and network maintenance, server/storage/device support and online/hybrid meeting arrangements.
